title: CMake Error: The current CMakeCache.txt directory is different than the directory where CMakeCache.txt was created (colcon, moved or mounted workspace), measured
excerpt: Why colcon fails after a ROS 2 workspace is moved or mounted at another path, why a cp -r copy passes but builds the original sources, and which fixes worked: rm -rf build install log and --cmake-clean-cache did, --cmake-clean-first did not. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
